_instructions: Measured CXT layout, version 9: physical positions take precedence over printed key caps. USB interface 0 must already use WinUSB; this file does not reprogram the keyboard.
Row 1: Claude/Codex | WeChat | Feishu | most recently used browser. Press again to return to the previous window.
Row 2: context 1..4 follows agent/chat/browser/video/default. Alt-only is context 4, released within 600 ms without another key.
Row 3: previous window / knob 1 press | copy | paste | overlay tap, hold for help, hold and rotate to move.
Row 4: Ctrl-only interrupt/Esc | Shift-only screenshot | send | clear editable input. Modifier taps only work through USB, never Raw Input.
Row 5: approve | deny | voice down/up (existing tap/hold configuration) | unbound single P pulse (shared with knob 2 counterclockwise).
Knob 1: F/S -> window next/prev, first step always previous window; L press confirms, or returns to previous window. Idle release 700 ms, watchdog 5 seconds.
Knob 2: R/P -> session next/prev (selection card only); Q selects. No window changes until pressed. Card closes after 2.5 seconds idle.
Knob 3: -/= -> scroll down/up over selected foreground pane, V -> next pane. Pointer stays there. Momentum scrolling, direction lock only.
Knob 4: ]/[ -> ctx next/prev, C -> ctx select. Agent question choices/templates; browser tabs; video seek; default arrows. Chat cycling is deferred.
Knob 1/2/4: first step two pulses, then 4/3/3 pulses (knob_divider overrides). Ignore isolated reverse pulses; two within 100 ms reverse, 250 ms idle resets, minimum step interval 90 ms.
Layers override global bindings. Exact device modifiers are required. Voice keeps existing release pairing. Raw Input leaks physical keys into applications and cannot run input actions safely.
Opt in with hub.py --backend usb --profile v2_emulation. The top-level default bindings stay unchanged. Physical codes below come from measured pc/deck_map.json; no keyboard reprogramming.
Slots 1..6: E, B, factory Ctrl+Z, Space, knob 2 press Q, knob 3 press V. G approves, factory Ctrl+F denies, hold H starts voice and release H stops it; knob 1 press L captures a screenshot.
All four knobs cycle sessions on rotation. Knob 4 press factory Ctrl+0 is the confirmed alternate interrupt key.

Four additional Ctrl+session prompt bindings are logical chords over known usages, pending a physical report capture. Ctrl+C and Ctrl+V remain unbound in every profile. The main PC keyboard Ctrl does not modify this USB device.

Factory Ctrl+Z already contains Ctrl, so Ctrl+slot 3 cannot be distinguished from slot 3. Factory Ctrl+F already contains Ctrl, so Ctrl+deny cannot be distinguished from deny. These two requested physical chords are pending an independently confirmed key; no guessed binding is installed.
Ctrl macros are decoded modifier-first: a Ctrl-only report then the main-key report. Fresh modifiers last until consumed by a main key. See hub_keys.md for labels and confirmation gaps.
